Subject: Quick recap + 3 options for a 30-min walkthrough (post-discovery)

Hi Emily / Rahul —

Thanks for your time today — great conversation on BrightCart's search and personalization priorities. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Goal: 30-minute product walkthrough focused on relevance improvements and inference cost estimates for your catalog (technical audience welcome).
- Success criteria for the session: stakeholder alignment on scope, confirm which metrics (CTR/revenue per visit) to evaluate, and identify an initial pilot dataset.

To keep momentum, can you pick one of these 30-minute windows? All times are in PDT. If none work, tell me your team's preferred blocks and we'll adapt.

Option A: Thu 9/16 10:00–10:30 AM
Option B: Thu 9/16 2:00–2:30 PM
Option C: Fri 9/17 11:30 AM–12:00 PM

Who should we invite from your side? For this session we recommend product/ops + one technical owner (engineering or infra) so Marcus (cc'd) can tailor the demo depth. If you want a deeper infra discussion, we can instead schedule a separate technical deep dive (45–60m).

Attaching the short post-call deck we referenced — it has the suggested agenda and a rough cost/latency estimate for a 2M-item catalog.

Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162
Redwood Inference
